Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog: Refines Custom Relay settings for faster in-game setup: Relay audiences now live under Privacy, selecting a Relay activates Custom visibility, invitation codes join directly, Join/Create/Rename actions share their input rows, and the redundant management reload action is removed.
